post.text:
He used Claude (post-update "skills" mode) to code a simple Python bot in ~2 nights via the Polymarket API.

The bot:
- Scans markets every few seconds
- Compares current share price (implied prob) vs its estimated true prob (via basic model + data feeds)
- Buys undervalued shares when edge > threshold (e.g. market 30¢ but true ~55¢)
- Holds briefly until repricing, then auto-sells

366 trades, 62% win rate. Started $1,430 → $238k in 11 days. Biggest: $52.7k on a Trump crypto EO market (28¢ in → 81¢ out). Pure edge on mispricings, no insider info.
